div.div:
build_long_observation_select_sql
Input: ONE successful manifest + its recorded chunks
See Generic flow for CTE internals.
Important contracts:
- successful_chunks validates non-empty, Time-first parameters before [2:] slicing
- observation and parameter lengths match
- successful run LEFT JOIN preserves one sentinel when no non-time values exist
- source fill values remain raw and are flagged
